name: @acos-vendor/ghl-mcp-node
description: Vendored Node (ESM) port of the GoHighLevel sub-account MCP server. Hand-maintained from vendor/ghl-mcp/main.py — same 91 tools, same GHL REST contract — so testers can connect their own GHL sub-account with no Python runtime. See ../VENDORED.md for provenance and refresh.sh for the dep-install procedure. Spawned via Electron's bundled Node (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1), mirroring flo-mcp-servers.
